correctness.rationale: For all nonnegative measurable radial W with 0<m_j<infty and exterior-dominated entire f,g with nonconstant quotient, strict Cauchy–Schwarz gives log-convex moments, hence T=R B has w_1=1 and w_n^2<=m_1^2/(m_0m_2)<1 for n>=2. The exact transverse shift gap is delta_W dist(v,Cz)^2 with delta_W=1-m_1^2/(m_0m_2). The meromorphic exterior quotient has finitely many interior poles, hence is rational; reversal gives a Schur H and f=H(T)g. Schur factorization H=(a+w psi)/(1+conj(a)w psi) yields exact deficit (1-|a|^2)[||u||²-||Tu||²+||Tu||²-||psi(T)Tu||²], both pieces nonnegative. Quadratic Mobius witnesses g=z(z+conj(a) eta R), f=z(az+eta R), u=z² attain delta for every fixed admissible a and weight. Independent exact examples delta=1/2 for Gaussian moments and 1/13 for thin ring d=1/2; no need for numerical extension to all weights.
